verses.text: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
lines: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation.
Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

verses.text: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
lines: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me?
Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.text: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
lines: Oh, send out your light and your truth.
Let them bring me to your holy hill,

verses.text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
lines: Then I will go to the altar of God,
I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

verses.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
lines: Why are you in despair, my soul?
Why are you disturbed within me?
For I shall still praise him:
my Savior, my helper, and my God.
